vivo.title: How it is right now
vivo.empty: No one has reported yet. Tell us how it is.
vivo.hiddenOwn: Your report is hidden by moderation. Only you can see it.
vivo.shareLocationHint: Uses your location once to check that you are nearby. It is not saved.
vivo.locReady: Ready: it will say "Near the place" if you are within 1 km.
vivo.locDenied: We could not use your location; the report will go without the "Near the place" mark.
vivo.publishError: We could not post your report. Try again.
vivo.reported: Thank you. We will review the report.
vivo.reportedHidden: Thank you. The report was hidden while we check it.
vivo.reportError: We could not send the report.
vivo.loginText: Sign in with your account in Settings to report how a place is or to flag a report.
